description: This Java class 'StatisticTestUtils' provides utility methods for setting up and manipulating test data related to books, including creating books with various ratings, genres, and pages, and tracking statistics such as total ratings and books per year. It is used for testing statistical computations within the book project.

classes.name: StatisticTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class for setting up and managing test data related to books and their statistics in unit tests.

methods.name: populateReadBooks
methods.description: Populates the test data with a set of books having various ratings, genres, and pages for testing purposes.

methods.name: addReadBook
methods.description: Adds a single read book with specified attributes to the test data.

methods.name: createReadBook
methods.description: Creates a book marked as read with specific attributes, updates statistics accordingly.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Creates a Book object with specified title, shelf, genre, pages, and start date.

methods.name: saveBook
methods.description: Saves a book via the BookService and adds it to the internal list.

methods.name: updateTotalRating
methods.description: Updates the total rating sum based on a given rating.

methods.name: reduceTotalRating
methods.description: Reduces the total rating sum based on a given rating.

methods.name: updateThisYearRating
methods.description: Updates the rating sum for the current year.

methods.name: getBookWithLowestRating
methods.description: Returns the book with the lowest rating.

methods.name: getBookWithHighestRating
methods.description: Returns the book with the highest rating.

methods.name: getBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Returns the book with the most pages.

methods.name: getBookWithLowestRatingThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the lowest rating read this year.

methods.name: getBookWithHighestRatingThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the highest rating read this year.

methods.name: getNumberOfBooks
methods.description: Returns the total number of books added.

methods.name: getNumberOfBooksThisYear
methods.description: Returns the number of books read in the current year.

methods.name: getTotalNumberOfPages
methods.description: Returns the total number of pages across all books.

methods.name: deleteBook
methods.description: Deletes a book from the data and updates statistics.
